diagnosis: Enterprise account on unified_auth is seeing sustained 429s across a ~20-minute nightly batch window, with customer-reported peak of roughly 5,400 rpm. This is a change request for a ceiling increase, which per kb-0004 requires a capacity review; the customer has already supplied the peak sustained rate and measurement window. Sustained (not burst) 429s point to the plan ceiling rather than a transient spike (kb-0014), so backoff guidance alone will not resolve the batch failures.
reply:
Thanks for the detail on your nightly reconciliation run, including the peak sustained rate and the window over which it was measured — that is exactly what we need for a rate limit increase request.

Per our policy on rate limit increases (kb-0004), increases above the plan ceiling require a capacity review, so I am unable to confirm any change to your limit here. In the meantime, please make sure your client honours the Retry-After header returned with each 429 and applies jitter to its retries (kb-0014); sustained 429s across an entire window usually indicate the plan ceiling is being hit rather than a short burst, so spreading or pacing the batch can reduce the impact while your request is reviewed.

I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
